findings.reason: a decision record for the confirmation is required, and s6/s7 must either be stored blocked behind it or the rationale must stop asserting the gate.
findings.text: the version-31 rationale says "Sections 6 and 7 stay unbuilt until the lead confirms the local model on this result or chooses otherwise", but the plan has no open decision for that confirmation (the only undecided faces are `full-enrichment-cost-accepted` and `local-lane-accepted`, on other questions), the `description-model` decision still carries `data-choice="local-after-retest"` as a settled choice, `plan-section-declarations` marks s6 and s7 `implementable`, and section 3's done-when is met only formally ("the lead's choice of model ... is recorded"). A dispatch reading s6 therefore sees the local model already chosen and the section buildable, while the plan's own newest evidence (local description preferred in 0 of 40 pairs; 111 of 200 judged wrong against 32 for the paid model) says the choice is unresolved.

findings.reason: the confirmation the plan now demands cannot be made from a count with no threshold or comparison, so s6 needs a stated quality bar, or the paid arm beside it, before dispatch.
findings.text: section 6 requires "for forty member signals chosen before the run, a hand comparison against the functional specification with the count that are right, partly right and wrong" and nothing else about quality, so the section cannot fail on quality: any count satisfies it, and the lead has no figure to weigh against the paid model's 16% wrong rate that this plan records. With the version-31 rationale making quality the open question, the plan's deciding measure has no endpoint.

response_events.note: Version 32 adds the open decision local-model-confirmed-on-quality scoped to sections 6 and 7, so both are held by a recorded decision and not by prose.

Section 6's done-when at version 33 sets a bar of at most eight wrong in forty, taken from the paid model's measured 32 in 200, and says a miss is delivered as failed on quality for the lead to decide.
